result.requirement: The system shall manage the full lifecycle of Store Partner Agreements, enabling the creation, amendment, and historical tracking of commercial terms while controlling access to these documents.
result.business_need: The business needs to maintain legally binding, auditable records of commercial terms to ensure operational compliance and accurate financial settlements with store partners.
functional_behaviour: The system shall allow the Platform Operator to create new agreements or amend existing ones with updated commercial terms.
The system shall automatically generate a new version of the agreement upon any amendment and retain the previous version in the history.
The system shall enforce access provisioning so that only authorized actors can view or edit specific agreement versions.
The system shall prevent the execution of orders against a Store Partner Agreement that is marked as inactive or superseded.
The system shall provide a version history view allowing the Platform Operator to compare changes between agreement versions.
The system shall notify the Store Partner of any changes to their active agreement terms.
business_rules: An amendment to an active agreement must immediately create a new version number while marking the previous version as historical.
A Store Partner Agreement must be marked as 'Active' before any associated Order Requests can be allocated to that partner.
Access to edit an agreement version is restricted to the Platform Operator and the Store Partner associated with that agreement.
The system must prevent the deletion of any agreement version once it has been created.

acceptance_criteria.given: The Platform Operator initiates an amendment to an active Store Partner Agreement
acceptance_criteria.when: The system processes the amendment request
acceptance_criteria.then: A new version of the agreement is created with updated terms, and the previous version is archived as historical data.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Store Partner attempts to allocate an Order Request to a partner with an inactive agreement
acceptance_criteria.when: The Order Allocation Engine validates the partner status
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the allocation and prevents the creation of the Delivery Assignment.
